name: Vaishnavi Yadav
bio: Vaishnavi Yadav is an independent researcher based in New Delhi, India, and a Research Collaborator at the Augmented Human Lab, National University of Singapore, where she works on inferring stress and affect from wearable sensor data. Her work explores how AI can support people in everyday life. Previously, she was a Research Associate at the ICTD Lab, IIT Delhi, where she built AI-driven decision-support tools for rural water conservation, and worked as an AI/ML engineering intern in industry. She was a finalist in the Gates Foundation ICO AI Fellows Program in 2026. She holds a B.Tech from JSS Academy of Technical Education, Noida (2023). Her research interests lie in human-centred AI, wearable and context-aware systems, and AI for social impact.
